normalization: L2 normalized per sequence initially. Matrix scaling applied via exact formula: np.hstack([0.75*t, 0.20*p, 0.05*n3]).
tonic_method: Pre-existing estimated tonic from extraction pipeline
temporal_aggregation: Top-50% most confident sequences (num_seq = max(1, int(len(rs) * 0.5)))
MAX_strategy: Geometric score uses MeanPrototype (mean of references for that training recording) in the frozen 45.02% code.
probability_calibration_method: Platt Scaling via 5-fold CV on TRF TRAIN
